description: Create a WEEEK task. Accepts project/column/assignee by NAME or id, a natural-language `due` date, a priority (low, medium, high, hold), a type (action, meet, call), a `parent` task id for a subtask, and custom-field values in `fields` by field name (global and project fields). One call — no need to look up ids first. Omit `assignee` to self-assign; to change assignees later use weeek_add_assignees / weeek_remove_assignees.

fields.description: Custom-field values by field name or id. text/link: a string; number: a number; boolean: true/false; datetime: a natural-language date or time; select: an option name; multiselect: option names; member/approval: member names; contact: a contact name or id; null clears the field.

parent.description: Id of the task this one becomes a subtask of.

name: weeek_create_task
